mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate starts (HOUST) signals strong demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tightening monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% YoY signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS YoY < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is flat or declining, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO flat or declining
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 YoY < 1% and INDPRO is flat or declining.
